source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1961, p. 20 ("Notice of result of elections: Rural District of Antrim")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: the full notice of result read on the Belfast Telegraph page of 2 June 1961.

note: Triennial election of Antrim Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. There was no contest in any division; the returning officer's notice of result lists the member returned or deemed re-elected for each of the 25 divisions. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
